Use case: identity-preserve.
Create one isolated full-body static game character master of Yeoman Kelly Chambers in her STANDARD CERBERUS CREW UNIFORM from the ORIGINAL Mass Effect 2 (2010), for Armax Relay Clash.
Use the three complementary game screenshots provided. Input1: Kelly is the red-haired woman standing at the LEFT of the elevator; this is the entire-body pose and lower-uniform reference, including the white outer-thigh utility panels, black trousers, black shin-high boots and ungloved hands. Ignore Joker in the foreground, the creatures and the environment. Input3: exact original auburn side-swept short bob, green eyes and face structure.

Do not turn the uniform into armor, a dress or a catsuit. Keep the white-grey utility panels at the upper outer thighs and dark fitted trousers and boots beneath, as actually shown. No weapons, gloves, additions, long hair or Legendary Edition hairstyle.
Aim for fidelity to the actual game model and its facial proportions, with clear modest detail and neutral lighting. Do not redesign her face or make it a glamour fashion portrait.
Single full body only, on a real transparent RGBA background. No scenery, elevator, other character, caption, text, base or cast ground shadow. Both hands and boot soles must be fully in frame. Leave at least 8 percent transparent space above her hair and below the boots; do not crop or zoom.
